column1: # Card R-14 (2026-11-26): the 25 jobs card R-12 held because no saved provider record states a licence for them.
# DEC-80 (the PI, 2026-11-26 about 08:41 CST: "all personal use, no worries re license i approve") lifts that hold.
# It does not make a licence: each line is copied unchanged from _batch6.tsv or _batch6b.tsv, licence field as
# the worker wrote it. These sets are redistributable: false (DEC-80 (3), DEC-51). Five tab-separated fields for
# scripts/orchestrator/fetch_to_tower.sh. See tower_jobs/README.md and planning/measurements/2026-11-26_tower_job_lists.md.
# Order as card R-12 ordered its lists: release first, then smallest first (provider bytes, else the worker's size
# statement, else last).
# Release r26.11.6 (DEC-79 moves RMD1 there); every other set below has no release assigned by a decision row.
